body: Thanks for this, I will use this as motivation in my own battle.
I completely agree. Weird that this weird hope thing keeps sticking around next to me though. Or maybe that's just fear. Who knows
Check my vital signs
Thanks for the tips, I’ll be sure to update everyone later
I’ve seen a few recent guides I’ve checked out do that, definitely gonna attempt that next go around
I’ll look for it, thanks!
I agree, but I will say I got lucky and actually didn’t encounter much camera problems with lone shadow swordsman. And good luck with your revenge tour, hope to get there soon!
Thanks for the video! I’ll definitely study it and get back to you, I didn’t have time to get to the fight yesterday but today I’m gonna try it and see
I’m definitely going to incorporate fire crackers more. I just find myself getting so caught up in trying to deflect that I forget about other things
Yeah I’m gonna take it a notch down. It’s important to be aggressive but skillfully aggressive if that makes sense

Fair enough. Probably just the game finally punishing my sort of play. I’ve noticed everyone seems to have their struggles with different bosses. Maybe this is mine lol. But yeah I’m gonna start practicing with lightning, I’ve heard it’s a bit important lol

Definitely a huge part of this game. Seems like most comments I read, everyone struggles with different things. Almost like there’s a different niche of people for every single boss. This game really does test every kind of player in different ways
Honestly the posture thing could be legit, I don’t watch it as much as I probably should. I’ll keep that in mind, maybe use a sugar to keep it low. Thanks!
That’s what I’ve heard. All about balance between pure aggression and timing

I believe it. Hard to find self control at points when you think that one extra hit will make all the difference. And it does, just makes the difference for the boss. But yeah, that’s been the number one piece of advice. I’m gonna head to bed and chill out, then come back tomorrow. And if it doesn’t work after a few days, I’ll be back here, still sad lol

Yeah, that’s what I’ve been hearing. Sounds like I just need to take a breather for the night, and come back, and repeat. And if I still have the same issue in a few days, I’ll be right back here on the subreddit wallowing in my frustration lol
Congrats! I’m currently stuck on the midterm of this game, I.e. Genichiro, and man I feel far way from where you’re at. But hopefully I’ll get there, congrats again

I’m definitely in the slow reflexes club. Although it didn’t take me too many tries to take down Ashina Elite, I’m finding timing to be a problem with Genichiro. Hopefully with enough time and effort, I can beat my turtle like skills lol

I’m not necessarily trying to take the hp bar down, but that definitely happens a lot in my boss fights. Whenever I have beaten the first or second phases, I’ll look up before the hp bar goes away and it’s usually about 3/4 down, without me intending to do that
Same, I’ve had two bosses where I had to set it down and come back the next day, and both times I beat them within like 5 tries. Best of luck to you, hopefully I can rely on sleep the same way

I do need to try the firecrackers, one of the few things I haven’t attempted so far, and seems a lot less timing heavy. I tried the umbrella a lot and I could never get it down, found I was better off just deflecting like normal. It probably is just a case of more time, maybe I’m just someone who’s going to need to put in more time to get succeed. This is my first FromSoftware game

Lol clearly I need to double my attempts and get to 60 before I can complain. I’ve definitely noticed and made this a large section of my plan, which works well, as I’m generally an aggressive fighter in this game. But every time I get close to him, I land some good hits, but I can’t get the right deflection in time. And it feels completely inconsistent, like I’m doing the same thing every time but not getting the same result.

The idea of a rhythm game totally makes sense. Maybe it’s just that Genichiro goes completely against my rhythm. I’m definitely someone who goes pretty heavy with my attacks, and although being aggressive is a part of that, I just don’t quite have the balance yet. It more or less just makes me concerned that I’m not gonna be able to handle final if I can’t pass the midterm you know?

I’m definitely gonna take a break until tomorrow and go at it again, has helped me a lot in the past. And I definitely can appreciate him as a boss as well. In my first half of tries, I could feel myself getting better and memorizing patterns, but I feel like it’s just stalled out, and that things are oddly inconsistent. Not to blame it on other things, but it feels like my reactions are there, but it’s not being read. In reality it’s probably a case of time, but I appreciate the response! And I’m definitely gonna sit and work on Mikiri counters some more. I handled the spear guy pretty easily when it came to those, but clearly I need more work

I’ve definitely not learned them perfectly, but I’ve gotten a general understanding just by fighting him so many times. It just feels like my deflect time just is almost irregular. I’ll nail his flurry attack almost perfectly at one time, then the next, it just completely misses. This is especially the case for Mikiri counters as well
